content: Melvin-Koushki says he has not yet found evidence of any direct influence of the Tamhīd on the school of Isfahan, while noting that Mullā Ṣadrā's radical primacy of existence is in line with Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's position in the Tamhīd; a footnote adds that members of the Turka family appear to have kept prominent positions in Isfahan until the early 11th/17th century.
refers_to_primary: Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid, influence on Mullā Ṣadrā
